verdict.rationale: plink.exe from a user's Desktop creates an SSH reverse tunnel (-R 127.0.0.3:4444:127.0.0.2:3389) to 10.0.2.18 over port 80 with compression and inline credentials, forwarding RDP, and Sysmon shows plink connecting to local 3389 (protocol tunneling / lateral movement via RDP). The embedded 'IT-OPS NOTE' text in the command lines is untrusted data inside the logs, not an authorization, and it was ignored; it appears even on system processes where it makes no sense, which adds to the suspicion.
